device_name: COALITION AGX Anterior Cervical Plate for ACDF

specs.By Material: PEEK Solid block , Titanium Plasma Sprayed , Allograft (Structural) , PEEK/Titanium , Titanium etched

description:
The COALITION AGX anterior cervical plate is a multi-use plate intended to be used in conjunction with the complementary cages such as the HEDRON IC (3D printed titanium ACDF spacer), COALITION AGX PEEK (ACDF PEEK interbody spacer), COALITION AGX Allograft (Cortical bone ACDF spacer),
The AGX plate comes in 2 profiles:
- COALITION AGX RP Plate (reduced profile)
- COALITION AGX standard profile (see photo)
